baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated clauses يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ and يُنَزِّلُ لَكُم ... رِزْقًا address the same plural recipients, while وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ narrows successful uptake.
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative showing makes marks publicly available and downward delivery makes benefit materially available, but neither availability guarantees recognition. The exception clause relocates the decisive difference into the recipient: return converts exposed sign and received gift into active remembrance.

activation_trace.role: إراءة وإظهار supplies the causative act of making something available to another's sight.
The visible mark supplies inspectable content rather than a bare assertion.
إنزال الشيء وإيصاله supplies directed delivery from the giver to the addressed recipients.
The apportioned gift makes the descended object a benefit assigned to recipients.
Re-presencing after forgetting supplies the inward conversion of available evidence into recognition.
Habitual return supplies the directional response that completes the disclosure-gift circuit.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists signs and provision, then adds that a repentant person remembers.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages universally addressed disclosure and supply but selectively completed uptake: exposed marks and delivered benefit become remembrance only through recurrent reorientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired forms يَتَذَكَّرُ and يُنِيبُ bind recovery of what has slipped from presence to repeated directional return.
baseline_models.mechanism: Remembering is not acquisition of wholly new information: the signs have already been shown and provision has already arrived. The remembrance branch restores an absent object to presence, while both return inventories supply recurrence; inabah is therefore the repeated operation by which disclosed reality is brought back into governing awareness.

activation_trace.role: استحضار الشيء بعد النسيان supplies recovery into present awareness.
The reminder image makes shown signs and received provision possible prompts for renewed presence.
رجوع الشيء مرة بعد أخرى supplies recurrence rather than a one-time turn.
Repeated return to a place or direction sharpens inabah as sustained reorientation toward a fixed source.

changed_reading.before: Only a person already disposed to repentance takes heed.
changed_reading.after: Taking heed is itself recursive: the returner repeatedly restores already-given signs and gifts to effective presence before they fade into familiarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens with the Book's tanzil, whose branches combine composed writing with placement into a fitting station. When the focus later coordinates shown signs with descending provision, verbal revelation and material sustenance become two ordered deliveries: each arrives in a form and location through which its source can be read.

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in its proper station lets the focus descent be tested as ordered placement, not mere downward motion.
The visible mark supplies the readable side of the focus delivery.
The opening tanzil activates ordering and fitting placement as the surah's first mode of descent.
Composed letters and the written object supply an organized, legible product of descent.

structural_cues: 40:2 establishes ن ز ل with the Book before 40:13 repeats the root for provision.
In 40:13 the same subject coordinates showing signs and sending provision to the same audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo, composed writing, and fitting placement; I infer that the two descents share an ordering-and-delivery mechanism. A live alternative is that the echo marks only a common divine source while keeping revelation and provision functionally separate.

changed_reading.before: The Book descends verbally near the opening, while material provision descends independently in the focus.
changed_reading.after: The focus belongs to a surah-wide economy of ordered descent in which readable message and situated sustenance are coordinated forms of delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The return in يُنِيبُ is framed by an accepter at the surah's opening, a destination toward Him, a declared common return, and an explicit call-answer exchange. Inabah thus becomes relational motion: the recipient repeatedly answers a summons toward one who receives the turn, rather than merely correcting an interior state.

activation_trace.role: Habitual return supplies the repeated movement whose relational endpoints context discloses.
Acceptance with satisfaction supplies a receiving side for the act of return.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the fixed destination named before the focus.
Return to a prior place supplies the declared common terminus of all competing calls.
Calling by speech supplies the summons to which reorientation can respond.
Answering speech supplies reciprocity rather than a one-way human movement.

structural_cues: 40:3 places acceptance of tawb and the destination toward Him before the focus's يُنِيبُ.
40:43 and 40:60 later align return, call, and answer while rejecting rival calls.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acceptance, destination, return, summons, and answer; I connect them into a reciprocal orientation circuit centered on يُنِيبُ. The live alternative is to keep inabah as unilateral devotion and treat call-answer as a separate prayer scene.

changed_reading.before: Inabah is an individual's inward repentance that permits remembrance.
changed_reading.after: Inabah is repeatedly answering a received call and moving toward an accepting destination; remembrance occurs inside that reciprocal relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visible marks do not mechanically yield recognition. The earlier response path twists them into interlocking dispute, covers them, mistakes unstable gleam for substance, and repeatedly turns things off their face; later sealing fixes that response. The focus exception therefore names a counter-turn: inabah repeatedly restores orientation where argumentative processing repeatedly reverses it.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark is the common input that can be processed in opposed ways.
Repeated return supplies the restorative response path.
Interlocking contention supplies a processing mode that knots evidence into adversarial exchange.
Covering supplies active occlusion despite the sign's availability.
A gleam that does not hold supplies the deceptive surface by which movement through the lands misleads.
Turning a thing off its face supplies the directional inversion opposed to inabah.
Imprinting and sealing supplies the later fixation of repeated argumentative reversal.

structural_cues: 40:4 and 40:13 both place response to signs inside a negation-plus-exception construction: none disputes except one class, and none remembers except another.
The phrase disputing about God's signs recurs at 40:35 and 40:56, turning the early contrast into a surah-wide response pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the mirrored exceptions and images of knotting, covering, deceptive sheen, reversal, and sealing; I infer two competing evidence-processing loops. A live alternative is that تَقَلُّب refers only to prosperous travel and contributes warning, not cognitive reversal.

changed_reading.before: Shown signs simply fail to persuade people who do not repent.
changed_reading.after: The same visible input bifurcates: one loop covers and reverses it through dispute, while recurrent return reorients it into remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah explicitly builds an earned accounting channel and then separates provision from it. Deeds are recompensed, earnings are counted, and an evil is answered only by its like; yet the admitted are provisioned without account. The focus's apportioned rizq is therefore assigned gift, not wage: measured source and fitting distribution need not mean merit-equivalent payment.

activation_trace.role: The apportioned gift supplies allocation while leaving its relation to desert open.
Reciprocal recompense establishes the moral return channel.
Acquired gain supplies the deed-side input to reckoning.
Counting and calculation make the recompense channel explicitly accountable.
Like-for-like response limits the negative recompense described immediately before provision.
The repeated provision root transfers the focus's gift category into the explicit no-account contrast.
Negated counting marks provision as exceeding the ledger that governs recompense.

structural_cues: 40:17 joins recompense, earning, and swift account.
40:40 first limits recompense to equivalence and then repeats ر ز ق with بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated accounting vocabulary and an explicit no-account provision; I infer two distinct distributive channels and read focus rizq through the gift channel. 'Without account' may alternatively emphasize immeasurable abundance rather than absence of merit, but either reading blocks a simple wage equation.

changed_reading.before: The descended rizq is an apportioned allotment that could sound like measured compensation.
changed_reading.after: The descended rizq is assigned generosity rather than moral wages; the surah counts recompense but lets provision overflow calculation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine showing is enacted through directed fieldwork: move across the earth, focus sight or insight, and read surviving marks as evidence of an earlier process and its outcome. Tadhakkur becomes reconstructive trace-reading, not passive exposure; the returner lets remains of the past correct present orientation.

activation_trace.role: Sight and insight supply the focus capacity later exercised through travel and looking.
The visible mark supplies the evidential object instantiated by historical remains.
Restoring the absent supplies the temporal work of inferring former causes from present traces.
Movement and passage make showing an itinerary rather than a stationary spectacle.
Directed sight or insight supplies deliberate examination.
A remaining mark that indicates what was supplies the historical evidence mechanism.
The repeated command-frame renews movement as an evidential practice near the surah's close.
Repeated directed looking confirms that physical exposure still requires interpretive attention.
Repeated remains close the surah with the same trace-to-outcome inference.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 nearly repeat the travel-look-outcome-stronger-traces sequence.
The second sequence follows 40:81's exact renewal of وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, deliberate looking, surviving effects, and repeated outcome frames; I infer that these آثار instantiate one mode of the focus's signs. A live alternative keeps آثار as supporting historical proof while reserving آيات in 40:13 primarily for revelation and natural phenomena.

changed_reading.before: God places signs before an observer who may or may not notice them.
changed_reading.after: God's showing also recruits the observer into moving, comparing, and reconstructing causes from remains; remembrance is disciplined historical perception.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recapitulation expands sky-provision into an inhabitable system: stable ground, sky as construction, formed bodies, and good provisions. The following staged bodily sequence runs from material origin through development to reasoning. Provision is thus not only an object falling from outside; it is the environmental and embodied support that makes a perceiving, remembering subject possible.

activation_trace.role: What is above and shelters supplies the environmental upper boundary of the focus descent.
Assigned benefit supplies the category later embedded in habitat and body.
Stability and settlement make the earth a support on which recipients can persist.
Building by joining parts makes the sky an organized shelter rather than only a source point.
Formed bodily image supplies the recipient-side architecture of provision.
The repeated provision root explicitly binds the recapitulated habitat to the focus gift.
Measured formation supplies the ordered developmental process of the recipient.
A continuum from drop to body supplies an inspectable material history within the recipient.
The restraint from ignorance supplies the cognitive endpoint named after the developmental sequence.

structural_cues: 40:64 repeats the focus's هُوَ/ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى, لَكُم, sky, and provision pattern while adding stable earth, built sky, and formed bodies.
40:67 follows with a material life-stage sequence ending in لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies environmental stability, construction, bodily form, provision, development, and cognition; I infer a coupled support system in which these conditions enable perception and remembrance. A live alternative treats 40:64 and 40:67 as adjacent but independent proofs rather than one causal system.

changed_reading.before: Provision is chiefly a descended commodity, plausibly rain or food, shown alongside signs.
changed_reading.after: Provision includes the stable habitat and formed, developing body that make seeing and reasoning possible; the recipient inhabits the sign before reflecting on it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus remembrance cannot mean mere eventual recall. Opponents are promised that they will remember the believer's words later, while he entrusts his affair now; only some promised outcome may be shown before universal return, and a sign is not demand-produced but permissioned. At the end, sight of overwhelming force yields faith that no longer benefits. Inabah therefore marks timely, actionable remembrance under partial noncoercive evidence, before forced seeing closes the response window.

activation_trace.role: Recovery into present awareness supplies the response whose timing context tests.
Repeated return supplies voluntary reorientation before evidential closure.
Predicted future recall proves that even opponents can remember after the useful decision point.
Entrusting the affair supplies the believer's present action before opponents' delayed recognition.
Causative showing repeats the focus verb while making the shown outcome explicitly non-exhaustive.
A part of a whole supplies partial disclosure rather than total closure.
Universal return supplies the endpoint that may arrive without the messenger seeing every promised event.
Permission supplies divine control over sign arrival and blocks demand-controlled proof.
Direct sight supplies the terminal, coercively clear evidence that arrives too late.
Negated benefit distinguishes late conviction from actionable remembrance.
Overwhelming force supplies the coercive object of final sight.
A running, repeated way makes the closed response window a stable historical pattern.

structural_cues: 40:44 contrasts the believer's present entrusting with opponents' future remembering.
40:77-78 joins partial showing, possible death before full outcome, universal return, and permissioned signs.
40:81-85 moves from renewed showing to historical inspection and finally to useless faith upon direct sight of force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delayed recall, present entrusting, partial and permissioned showing, universal return, and useless faith after coercive sight; I infer a temporal response window and assign inabah the role of acting within it. A live alternative is that late faith fails because punishment is its object, not because partial evidence defines a general window.

changed_reading.before: Only the returner is cognitively capable of remembering the signs.
changed_reading.after: Others may remember and even believe later; what belongs to the returner is timely, beneficial remembrance that acts under partial evidence before sight becomes coercive.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's form-distant ر ء ي→ر و ي and س م و→و س م mappings, making showing bodily quenching and sky a marking rain. It remains valid as an exploratory mechanism because those split inventories are packet-supplied and converge with the focus branches that call rain provision and an ayah a visible mark. Downstream prose should present it as a cross-branch activation, not as a claim that the focus words etymologically mean irrigation or marking.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا

activation_trace.role: Quenching thirst supplies the bodily reception side of divine showing.
First rain that marks earth with vegetation supplies a visible inscription produced by descent.
Rain named as provision connects nourishment directly to the marking event.
The visible mark supplies what the newly vegetated earth becomes.
Rain's downward arrival supplies the physical operation linking quenching to inscription.

changed_reading.before: God shows signs and separately sends rain-like provision.
changed_reading.after: The provision is self-displaying: descending rain quenches recipients and writes its arrival into the earth as visible growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads Pharaoh's tower as a counter-machine to the focus's grammatical direction. It remains anchored in the focus's causative showing, downward sending, and sky source, while 40:36-37 explicitly joins building upward, reaching sky-connections, attempted inspection, beautification, and blockage. Downstream prose should qualify it as a spatial and political analogy, not as an assertion that every ascent is condemned or that the passages state this contrast explicitly.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus has God cause sight and send provision downward from the sky; the later episode attempts to build upward in order to inspect.

activation_trace.role: Divine causative showing supplies receptive disclosure initiated from beyond the observer.
Directed downward delivery supplies the focus's vertical flow.
The sky as what is above supplies the vertical source named in the focus.
Construction by joined parts supplies the engineered apparatus of attempted access.
Reaching a limit supplies the ruler's intended upward endpoint.
A rope or connection supplies the imagined means by which the sky might be accessed.
The repeated heavens locate the attempted counter-flow in the focus's vertical domain.
Climbing to inspect or uncover supplies coerced visual capture in place of received showing.
Making an act appear beautiful supplies the internal distortion that makes the apparatus persuasive.
Turning away and blocking supplies the failed epistemic result of attempted capture.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply describes benevolent signs and provision descending from the sky.
changed_reading.after: The downward gift models receptive knowledge, while Pharaoh's engineered upward inspection becomes its failed coercive inverse: capture rises, but disclosure descends.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates ن ز ل as prepared guest-fare inside the verb of descent and combines it with the later contrast between temporary useful goods and a permanent abode. It remains anchored in يُنَزِّلُ لَكُم رِزْقًا and recurrent return, with 40:39 supplying travel-use and settlement branches. Downstream prose should render it as a hospitality or waystation metaphor, not as the lexical replacement of 'sends down' with 'hosts.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُنَزِّلُ لَكُم ... رِزْقًا and يُنِيبُ permit a host-gift-return configuration.

activation_trace.role: Prepared fare for a guest supplies hospitality as a latent image inside descended provision.
Assigned benefit supplies what the host makes available during the stay.
Habitual return supplies the guest's recurrent homeward orientation.
A useful thing for needs and onward sufficiency supplies waystation equipment rather than final possession.
Fixed settlement supplies the contrasted permanent abode toward which temporary fare points.

changed_reading.before: Provision is a commodity delivered for present use.
changed_reading.after: Provision can be carried as a host's prepared fare for a temporary stay; the one who returns receives it without mistaking the waystation for the settled home.

strongest_changes: The mirrored exception constructions make dispute-and-covering and return-and-remembrance rival processing loops for the same signs.
The surah distinguishes earned recompense from provision without account, preventing focus rizq from collapsing into wages.
Late recall and coerced sight can occur without benefit, so the focus privileges timely remembrance under partial evidence rather than mere eventual cognition.
Repeated travel-look-trace sequences turn divine showing into active historical reconstruction.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly re-ran the focus's core verbs in altered conditions: Book and provision descend, signs are disputed or traced, return becomes call-and-answer, and sight shifts from invitational to coercive. The split focus inventories also exposed a compact material reading in which rain both quenches and marks the earth.
remaining_uncertainties: The rain-as-inscription reading depends on form-distant split mappings and should remain exploratory rather than etymological.
The downward-disclosure/upward-capture contrast is a reader-supplied spatial arrow, though every element of the contrast is packet-anchored.
Provision 'without account' may foreground immeasurable abundance rather than a strict non-merit category, even though it still exceeds simple recompense.
